message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the CSV data or audio arrays loaded into the pipeline.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local filesystem paths (e.g., 'data/train.csv', 'data/train_audio') with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or source authentication present.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label values against an expected set, no label distribution comparison, and no use of any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is performed on the training samples at any point in the data preparation flow.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained/checkpoint weights via torch.load() from file paths specified in config without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision verification.

No detected label distribution validation: The code only reads the CSV and optionally drops duplicates for a sanity check, but performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous-sample detection before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop or supporting code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard PyTorch optimizers with no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or any other differential privacy mechanism.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: The validation split is created from the same training CSV using train_test_split without a fixed hold-out set, there is no signing/hashing of evaluation data, and only a single metric (mean F1 score) is tracked with no independent evaluation safeguards.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (TestDataset and Config loading) performs no shape, range, or schema validation on incoming audio data before passing it to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or output sanity validation are applied to the model's clipwise_output predictions anywhere in the inference code path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio classification model, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
